title: The Eelmen
text: Slick grey shapes rise around the boat, one after another, until you are ringed. The eelmen of the Marches, with round mouths full of teeth and long cold fingers on the gunwales. They want a toll, and they do not look like they take much else.

options.label: Pay their toll in fish and gold, and keep your fingers inside the boat.

outcomes.text: They sink away, one by one, cold fingers sliding off the gunwales, and you breathe again.

options.label: Fight them off the boat. No toll for things with mouths like that.

outcomes.text: In the water, where they are strongest, and there are many more below.

options.label: The shrewdest talks them into guiding you through the reeds instead.

outcomes.text: Through the reeds, quickly, with grey heads bobbing all around you.
